Usage:
  e2e login [provider] [--device] [--client-id <id>] [--from-gh] [--enterprise-url <host>]
  e2e logout [provider]
  e2e models [provider]
  e2e guide [topic]
  e2e install [chromium|firefox|webkit ...] [--with-deps]
  e2e mcp [--config <path>] [--target <name>] [--headed] [--max-sessions <n>]
  e2e explore [goal] [--config <path>] [--target <id>] [--agent <name>] [--max-steps <n>] [--timeout <ms>] [--headed] [--output <dir>]
               [--debug] [--ai-trace] [--trace [mode]] [--video [mode]]

e2e install downloads browsers for the Playwright version E2E runs. It installs chromium when no browser is named.

Providers:
  openai            ChatGPT Plus/Pro, the Codex sign-in (--device for a machine without a browser)
  github-copilot    GitHub Copilot (gh signed in, or --client-id of your OAuth App; --enterprise-url for GHE)
  opencode-console  OpenCode Console workspace (OpenCode Zen and Go)
  spacexai          SuperGrok or X Premium+

e2e explore runs the agent against the app toward a goal, without a test file, and reports its findings. e2e explore --help lists its options.

e2e mcp serves a coding agent such as Claude Code over MCP (stdio): the fixed tools and the guide
resources. Register it with: claude mcp add e2e -- e2e mcp

Credentials live in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/e2e/oauth.json (or ~/.config/e2e/oauth.json).
E2E_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS holding the same JSON stands in for the file. Use API keys in CI.

result.stdout:
Usage: e2e explore [options] [goal]

Run the agent against the app with a goal instead of a test: it plans one exploration step at a time, drives the app, reports every defect it has evidence of, and ends with an assessment. The model is the one the selected agent holds, as for a test.

goal                what to explore, in a sentence (default: "Explore the app and find bugs")

Selection:
  --config <path>   config file (default: the nearest e2e.config.json)
  --target <id>     the target to explore (default: the config's target)
  --agent <name>    the configured agent to explore with (default: agents.default)

Budgets:
  --max-steps <n>   exploration steps at most, 1 through 12 (default: 8)
  --timeout <ms>    wall clock in milliseconds, 180000 through 900000 (default: 600000)

Execution:
  --headed          show the UI while the agent explores

Output:
  --output <dir>    results directory: finding screenshots, trace pages, videos (default: .e2e/results)
  --debug           print phase timings and the agent step table to stderr (also E2E_DEBUG=1)
  --ai-trace        record every model call to ai-trace-<process id>.json next to the results directory (unbox-ai) (also E2E_AI_TRACE=1)
  --trace [mode]    keep a trace page of the exploration (bare: on); one attempt, so retry modes keep none. Modes: off, on, retain-on-failure, on-first-retry, on-all-retries (also E2E_TRACE)
  --video [mode]    record a video of the exploration (bare: on), when the engine supports it; one attempt, so retry modes record none. Modes: off, on, retain-on-failure, on-first-retry, on-all-retries (also E2E_VIDEO)

Accounts: every E2E_USER_<NAME>_USERNAME and E2E_USER_<NAME>_PASSWORD pair in the environment is an account the agent can sign in with. It fills the password by secret; the password never reaches a model.

Not supported by the .NET port: --session, --reporter (it refuses these).

Examples:
  e2e explore
  e2e explore "Explore the checkout flow like a first-time buyer and report anything off"
  e2e explore --target web --max-step
[truncated]
